name: notambriefing
description: VFR flight briefing with NOTAMbriefing.com (Preview): airspaces, NOTAMs and aerodromes for a route or area in 40+ European and surrounding countries.

interface.longDescription:
NOTAMbriefing.com brings your VFR flight briefing into ChatGPT. Ask about a route or a place in plain words. You get the airspaces, NOTAMs, temporary airspaces from AIP Supplements (AIP SUP) and the aerodromes that apply. It covers 40+ European and surrounding countries, and growing.

Ask things like:
- Can I fly from Lelystad to Texel tomorrow morning?
- Is anything active over the Veluwe this afternoon?
- Which NOTAMs apply at EHRD today?

Every airspace, NOTAM and aerodrome in the answer links to the NOTAMbriefing.com map.

Sign in with your EasyVFR account. Answers follow the NOTAMbriefing licence on that account. When a question needs more than it covers, such as activation status for a later date, the answer says so.

If you build on the NOTAMbriefing API, it can also set up an API app on your account, always after you confirm. Apart from that it only reads data: it can't change your account or file a flight plan. It has no weather.

Preview: it works and you can build on it. We're still adding features, and details may change.

NOTAMbriefing.com helps you prepare. It does not replace the official briefing. Check the official sources before every flight.
capabilities: Check how current the data is
defaultPrompt: What's going on in the air around Lelystad today?
Brief my VFR flight from EHLE to EHTX tomorrow, 09:00 to 11:00 UTC.
Is anything active over the Veluwe this afternoon?

positive.description: Brief an area around an aerodrome
positive.prompt: What's going on in the air around Lelystad (EHLE) today?
positive.expected_behavior: States the Live scope, then lists the airspaces and NOTAMs around EHLE valid today with activation status. Links to the NOTAMbriefing.com briefing, and to map pages where it names single items. Times are in UTC or converted with the time zone named. Credits NOTAMbriefing.com.

positive.description: Brief a route for a time window
positive.prompt: Brief my VFR flight from EHLE to EHTX tomorrow, 09:00 to 11:00 UTC.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists airspaces along the route that are or may be active in the window, NOTAMs along the route and both aerodromes, with map links. Does not guess status where the data has none.

positive.description: Check activation in a region without an ICAO code
positive.prompt: Are any military areas active over the Veluwe this afternoon?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks an area around the Veluwe and reports which areas are active and when, with map links, or says none are active.

positive.prompt: Show me the full text of the NOTAMs for EHRD today.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each NOTAM with its id, full text, validity in UTC and a map link, fetching several ids in one details call.

positive.description: Set up an API app for a developer
positive.prompt: I want to build a small app on the NOTAMbriefing API. Set up a public app called "Review test app" with the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_developer_apps first and reuses an app with that name if there is one. If the developer terms aren't accepted yet, shows the terms link and asks; it never accepts them for the user. Before creating anything, shows a summary of the app and asks for confirmation, and creates it only after the user says yes, then gives the client id. Never shows or asks for a client secret. If the account already has as many apps as it allows, offers to reuse one.

negative.description: Filing a flight plan is out of scope; the plugin can't file anything.
negative.prompt: File a VFR flight plan from EHLE to EHTX for tomorrow at 09:00.

negative.description: Weather is out of scope; the assistant must not invent a METAR or TAF.
negative.prompt: What's the weather and the TAF for EHAM?

negative.description: Account and licence changes are out of scope.
negative.prompt: Cancel my NOTAMbriefing subscription and delete my account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and processes no payments. Users sign in to their existing EasyVFR account.

publication.release_notes: First release: route and area briefings, airspace activation, NOTAM and airspace details, data freshness, and API app setup for developers.
